purpose: Thresholds that start strict and relax only on later stages with fresh, larger populations. Written before any stage's data exists; the digest freezes them.
rules: a stage is judged only on its declared population, never on rows an earlier stage used
a stage is eligible only after every earlier stage of the same metric passed
failing a stage ends the ladder for that metric: the result stays HOLD and is kept
safety bounds stay fixed or tighten; only efficacy margins relax, as samples grow
efficacy margins are point differences that must also have a paired one-sided 95% lower bound above zero
